screening_attempts.quarantine_resolution_reason: Operator release of Orsentra v33 (1e579393). The I4 finding concerns a records header that tells the deciding model a record naming someone only by a nickname is about the person that nickname belongs to (src/consts.rs:385, src/recall/contacts.rs:118-131). That is a retrieval heuristic grounded in the user's own records. It can be wrong, which the benchmark scores; it is not a benchmark bypass. Released under the 2026-11-07 operator ruling.
